content: # Bundesliga 2 promotion race and relegation battle: Who secured promotion and who went down? Elversberg, Paderborn and Hannover battled it out to join Schalke in the Bundesliga, while four teams were at risk of following Preußen Münster down to the third tier on a dramatic final day in Bundesliga 2... Schalke secured promotion to the Bundesliga after beating Fortuna Düsseldorf at home on Matchday 32. They were confirmed as Bundesliga 2 champions the following day after Paderborn failed to beat Elversberg. With Elversberg, Hannover and Paderborn level on 59 points heading into the final matchday, it was all to play for. Elversberg prevailed, beating relegated Preußen Münster 3-0 to secure a maiden promotion to the Bundesliga. Paderborn finished third after a 2-0 victory over Darmstadt, meaning they will play Wolfsburg in the play-off. It means that the Clover Leaves will play Rot-Weiss Essen for a place in next season's Bundesliga 2, while Fortuna follow Münster into Germany's 3.

title: 2 Bundesliga: The Battle To Follow Schalke Is On, And Who Can Avoid The Drop?
content: # 2 Bundesliga: The Battle To Follow Schalke Is On, And Who Can Avoid The Drop? Bundesliga match between FC Schalke 04 and Hertha BSC at Veltins-Arena on August 01, 2025 in Gelsenkirchen, Germany. With two match day remaining, three clubs still harbour realistic hopes of winning promotion to the Bundesliga in May. Each club vying for the coveted second place and promotion play-off spot represents something different—not only for their fans, but for German football as a whole. Meanwhile, at the opposite end of the table, the relegation race hasn’t been this open in years, with six teams fighting to secure another season in the second tier. In third place, with a superior goal difference to all except promoted side Schalke, and Elversberg, is Hannover 96. After falling short in last season’s relegation play-off against Heidenheim, securing promotion this time would rank among the most remarkable underdog stories in German football history.
